{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Get a unit's uniform insignia class set with [[BIS_fnc_setUnitInsignia]].

|s1= [target] call [[BIS_fnc_getUnitInsignia]]

|p1= target: [[Object]] - object from which to return its insignia's class

|r1= [[String]] - insignia classname

|x1= <sqf>private _insigniaClass = [player] call BIS_fnc_getUnitInsignia</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_setUnitInsignia]] [[Arma 3: Unit Insignia]]
